name: Zelda Again: Link Is Adventuresome
storyline: Upon noticing a the mark of the crest of hyrule on his back, Link seeks out Impa. Impa says that the mark on Link's hand means that he is the hero chosen to awaken Zelda. She gives Link a chest containing six crystals. The crystals must be set into statues within six palaces scattered across Hyrule. This will open the way to the Great Palace, which contains the Triforce of Courage. Only the power of the combined Triforces can awaken Zelda. Taking the crystals, Link sets out to restore them to their palaces. Meanwhile, Ganon's followers seek to kill Link, as sprinkling his blood on Ganon's ashes will bring Ganon back to life. Link now sets out to stop the revival of ganon, and wake up Zelda.
summary: Zelda Again: Link Is Adventuresome is a fan made remaster of Zelda II: The Adventure of Link with the intent to add more content to the game. This remaster ports the classic NES sequel to the first The Legend of Zelda but includes several new minor gameplay tweaks and features such as tons of quality of life improvements, widescreen, new areas on the overworld to explore, new collectibles and upgrades, revamped dungeon and overworld layouts and a brand new post game quest and final boss featured only in the game's new game plus mode, the 2nd Quest.
